summary.en-US: Fill job forms from your profile, attach CV, and draft cover letters with your AI provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Grok, OpenRouter).

description.en-US:
Apply Filler helps you complete job applications faster.

• Matches common form fields from your local profile (name, email, salary prefs, and more)
• Drafts cover letters and open questions with your chosen AI provider and API key
• Select text on a page → “Answer with AI” for quick replies you can copy or paste into fields
• Imports PDF/DOCX resumes locally; AI uses extracted resume text plus your custom prompt
• Supports hh.ru and other ATS-style apply forms
• Can auto-attach a resume you imported in Options
• Never submits forms for you — always review before sending

Your profile and API keys stay in browser storage. Vacancy text, resume excerpts, and question labels are sent to your selected AI provider only when you trigger Fill or Answer with AI.

version.approval_notes:
Uses pdfjs-dist and mammoth only on the Options page to parse resumes locally. Function constructor / dynamic import warnings come from those third-party parsers, not from the content script fill path.

v0.1.7: Answer with AI — minimum selection lowered to 2 chars, full question/answer shown in panel with scroll, higher token limit for longer replies.

Listed channel submission. Same add-on ID (apply-filler@local.dev).
